mentions.name: Project20x
mentions.description: The infrastructure layer and operating system that runs Codify: multi-tenant governance, AI agent orchestration, and domain-specific sys-cores for healthcare, education, and city services. Every US federal agency and state-level department has a subdomain (e.g. ed.usa.project20x.com, doj.usa.project20x.com, hhs.usa.project20x.com) with AI agents representing each agency's mandate. It hosts policy management for both parties (dnc.project20x.com and rnc.project20x.com) where legislative intent is codified into executable governance through a 10-step policy lifecycle; agency agents negotiate with each other and send policy proposals up to a human-in-the-loop politician for approval, and each elected official has a profile where constituents can engage.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The platform is Project20x — think of it as the infrastructure layer. If Codify is the verb ("codify your healthcare problem into a care program"), Project20x is the operating system that runs it all: multi-tenant governance, AI agent orchestration, and domain-specific sys-cores for healthcare, education, city services, etc.

Every US federal agency and state-level department has a subdomain — ed.usa.project20x.com (Dept of Education), doj.usa.project20x.com, hhs.usa.project20x.com, etc. — with AI agents representing each agency's mandate. Same structure at the state level.
